scope: Mac-local ECHO/PHAROS engine and playback repair; neither hosted website was deployed.

changes: Materialize constant vocoder weight normalization once before moving to MPS.
Decode bounded waveform windows on the GPU using the original global interpolation grid.
Warm speech kernels before reporting ready.
preserved: Existing single PHAROS LaunchAgent and loopback port 8765.
XTTS-v2.0.3 checkpoint and pinned reference recording.
Original server source, request guards, generation settings and Python environment.

engine_measurements.selected_profile_method: Synthetic English phrases; candidate runs use a fixed random seed of 26. Warm means kernels already exercised, not an audio-cache hit.
engine_measurements.comparison_limit: Diagnostic observations at different times under changing background load. The original run has an uncontrolled seed. These are not a controlled speedup estimate or a latency guarantee.
engine_measurements.equivalence_limit: Numerical comparison on one 94720-sample waveform; does not establish subjective speech quality or eliminate model transcription errors.

playback.cache: 32 MiB in process memory; execution profile or LaunchAgent changes invalidate the voice identity.
playback.browser: Chrome on the Mac; actual AudioBufferSource start/ended events, no speech fixture.
playback.synthetic_passage: The morning light reaches the window as ECHO begins reading. Each paragraph should follow smoothly while the next phrase is prepared. You can pause for a moment and continue whenever you are ready.
playback.pause_resume: Paused during second phrase; no new audio source during the pause; resumed the remaining audio and completed the third phrase.
playback.stop: Stopped while preparing a new run; no subsequent audio source started before final observation and reload.
playback.instrumentation_cleanup: Temporary timing wrappers removed by page reload; DevTools Network observation disabled.

regressions: Ordered bounded lookahead and initial buffering.
Cancellation, pause/resume, prefetch errors and cached access during another render.
Vocoder window coverage and missing model assets.
Cache invalidation for changed engine profile.
Installer rollback restores both entrypoint bytes and LaunchAgent; bounded retry for transient launchd registration error.
verification.installed_profile_health: status ok and exact profile SHA matched after final re-registration.
verification.service_registration_note: Final verification found the LaunchAgent absent after a successful installation receipt. Re-registered the same service, then verified live health and its running PID. Cause of the absent registration was not established; this is not a reboot or long-duration reliability test.

known_limits: Uncached startup still takes seconds, and short gaps remain. The measured final playback is not pause-free.
Heavy concurrent GPU or memory pressure changes latency. The active image render was allowed to finish successfully; only its idle model cache was released afterward.
In-flight model inference may finish after Stop; stale browser audio is discarded.
The selected profile changes execution, not the voice identity or underlying model speech fidelity. Half precision, int8 quantization and experimental streaming were not promoted.
Mac-local installation verified; PR remains unmerged and neither hosted ECHO site was deployed.
